opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death, working with them to find temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can return home. Provides financial support, fee waivers, additional funding, help negotiating placements, and visa/practical assistance for the academic and accompanying family members. Fellowships are typically 2- or 3-year awards.
